_doc: Advisory IDs that the security-audit workflow should NOT raise an alert for. Keep in lock-step with the 'Upstream advisories' section in README.md. Add a one-line reason for each; remove the entry when the advisory is fixed upstream so the next audit re-flags it if anything regresses.

advisories.reason: transitive via @sveltejs/kit; near-zero exposure (no user-controlled cookie names/paths). Re-raise if @sveltejs/kit ships an updated cookie peer.
